## function for exporting tables

```{r}

export_df_to_latex <- function(df, file_path, caption = NULL) {
  
  #-----------------------------
  # Helper: escape LaTeX specials
  #-----------------------------
  escape_latex <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", x)
    x <- gsub("([%&_#\\$])", "\\\\\\1", x)
    x <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", x)
    return(x)
  }
  
  # Convert to character
  df[] <- lapply(df, as.character)
  
  # Escape LaTeX characters
  df[] <- lapply(df, escape_latex)
  colnames(df) <- escape_latex(colnames(df))
  
  # Alignment: first left, rest right
  n_cols <- ncol(df)
  align_string <- paste0("l", paste(rep("r", n_cols - 1), collapse = ""))
  
  # Build body rows
  body_rows <- apply(df, 1, function(row) {
    paste(row, collapse = " & ")
  })
  
  body_rows <- paste0(body_rows, " \\\\")
  body_text <- paste(body_rows, collapse = "\n")
  
  # Header row
  header <- paste(colnames(df), collapse = " & ")
  header <- paste0(header, " \\\\")
  
  # Caption + label handling
  file_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_path))
  
  if (is.null(caption)) {
    caption_text <- gsub("_", " ", file_name)
  } else {
    caption_text <- caption
  }
  
  label <- paste0("tab:", file_name)
  
  # Build LaTeX table
  latex_table <- paste0(
"\\begin{table}[t]
\\centering
\\fontsize{12pt}{14pt}\\selectfont
\\begin{tabular}{@{\\extracolsep{\\fill}}", align_string, "}
\\toprule
", header, "
\\midrule\\addlinespace[2.5pt]
", body_text, "
\\bottomrule
\\end{tabular}
\\caption{", caption_text, "}
\\label{", label, "}
\\end{table}"
  )
  
  # Write file
  writeLines(latex_table, file_path)
  
  message("LaTeX table exported to: ", file_path)
}



```




## Summary stats for RI (across all grid-intervals)

```{r}
years <- start_year:end_year
intervals <- 625:635

RI_cols <- expand.grid(years, intervals) |>
  apply(1, \(x) paste0("cpc_index_", x[1], "_", x[2]))

# DM_cols <- expand.grid(years, intervals) |>
#   apply(1, \(x) paste0("DM_median_", x[1], "_", x[2]))


DM_cols <- expand.grid(years, intervals) |>
  apply(1, \(x) paste0("DM_median_", x[1], "_", x[2]))



#-----------------------------
# 1. Long format
#-----------------------------
df_long <- grids %>%
  select(STATE, any_of(RI_cols)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -STATE,
    names_to = "grid_interval",
    values_to = "RI"
  )

#-----------------------------
# 2. Classify payout status
#-----------------------------
df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(
    payout_class = case_when(
      RI <= 0.90 ~ "Payout",
      RI >  0.90 ~ "No Payout",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(payout_class))

#-----------------------------
# 3. State-level percentages
#-----------------------------
state_table <- df_long %>%
  group_by(STATE, payout_class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(STATE) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = payout_class,
    values_from = percent
  )

#-----------------------------
# 4. Total row
#-----------------------------
total_row <- df_long %>%
  group_by(payout_class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n)) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = payout_class,
    values_from = percent
  ) %>%
  mutate(STATE = "TOTAL") %>%
  select(STATE, everything())

#-----------------------------
# 5. Combine + round + reorder
#-----------------------------
final_table <- bind_rows(state_table, total_row) %>%
  mutate(
    Payout     = paste0(round(Payout * 100), "%"),
    `No Payout` = paste0(round(`No Payout` * 100), "%")
  ) %>%
  select(STATE, Payout, `No Payout`) %>%
  arrange(STATE == "TOTAL", STATE)   # puts TOTAL last

final_table

export_df_to_latex(
  df = final_table,
  file_path = here("data/outputs/tables/state_RI_payout_table.tex"),
  caption = "RI payout frequencies by state, 2010-2025"
)



```

## RI Combos, updated code (DIFFERENT VALUES!!)

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(sf)

#-------------------------------------------------
# Settings
#-------------------------------------------------
high_drought_threshold <- 4
ri_threshold <- 0.90
years <- 2010:2025
intervals <- 625:635

#-------------------------------------------------
# 1. Pivot DM long (SAFE)
#-------------------------------------------------
# Add a unique grid cell ID before pivoting
dm_long <- grids %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(grid_id = row_number()) %>%          # <-- add this
  select(GRIDCODE, STATE, starts_with("DM_median_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(GRIDCODE, STATE),
    names_to = "var",
    values_to = "DM"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    var = str_remove(var, "^DM_median_"),
    year = as.integer(str_sub(var, 1, 4)),
    interval = as.integer(str_sub(var, 6))
  ) %>%
  select(-var)

ri_long <- grids %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(grid_id = row_number()) %>%          # <-- add this
  select(GRIDCODE, STATE, starts_with("cpc_index_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(GRIDCODE, STATE),
    names_to = "var",
    values_to = "RI"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    var = str_remove(var, "^cpc_index_"),
    year = as.integer(str_sub(var, 1, 4)),
    interval = as.integer(str_sub(var, 6))
  ) %>%
  select(-var)

# Now join on grid_id + year + interval — guaranteed 1:1
grids_long <- dm_long %>%
  left_join(ri_long, by = c("GRIDCODE", "STATE", "year", "interval")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DM), !is.na(RI))

#-------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create combo classification
#-------------------------------------------------
grids_long <- grids_long %>%
  mutate(
    case_high_drought = DM >= high_drought_threshold,
    case_ri_threshold = RI <= ri_threshold,
    combo = factor(
      paste(case_high_drought, case_ri_threshold, sep = "_"),
      levels = c("FALSE_FALSE", "FALSE_TRUE",
                 "TRUE_FALSE", "TRUE_TRUE"),
      labels = c("No drought without payout",
                 "No drought with payout",
                 "Drought without payout",
                 "Drought with payout")
    )
  )

#-------------------------------------------------
# 5. Aggregate by state
#-------------------------------------------------
combo_summary <- grids_long %>%
  group_by(STATE, combo) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(STATE) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = combo,
    values_from = percent
  )

#-------------------------------------------------
# 6. TOTAL row
#-------------------------------------------------
total_row <- grids_long %>%
  group_by(combo) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n)) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = combo,
    values_from = percent
  ) %>%
  mutate(STATE = "TOTAL") %>%
  select(STATE, everything())

#-------------------------------------------------
# 7. Combine
#-------------------------------------------------
final_combo_table <- bind_rows(combo_summary, total_row)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 8. Format as percentages
#-------------------------------------------------
final_combo_table <- final_combo_table %>%
  mutate(
    across(-STATE,
           ~ paste0(round(.x * 100, 1), "%"))
  )

final_combo_table


export_df_to_latex(
  df = final_combo_table,
  file_path = here("data/outputs/tables/RI_DM_combo.tex"),
  caption = "Combinations of RI Payouts and DM Exceptional drought classifications, 2010-2025"
)




```


## State payout rates

```{r}

#====================================================
# 1. Settings
#====================================================
years <- 2010:2025
intervals <- 625:635
ri_threshold <- 0.90

usdm_colors <- c(
  "-1" = "#AAAAAA",
  "0"  = "#FFFF00",
  "1"  = "#FCD37F",
  "2"  = "#FFAA00",
  "3"  = "#E60000",
  "4"  = "#730000"
)

#====================================================
# 2. Pivot DM long
#====================================================
dm_long <- grids %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(grid_id = row_number()) %>%
  select(grid_id, STATE, starts_with("DM_median_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(grid_id, STATE),
    names_to = "var",
    values_to = "DM"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    var = str_remove(var, "^DM_median_"),
    year = as.integer(str_sub(var, 1, 4)),
    interval = as.integer(str_sub(var, 6))
  ) %>%
  select(-var)

#====================================================
# 3. Pivot RI long
#====================================================
ri_long <- grids %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(grid_id = row_number()) %>%
  select(grid_id, STATE, starts_with("cpc_index_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(grid_id, STATE),
    names_to = "var",
    values_to = "RI"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    var = str_remove(var, "^cpc_index_"),
    year = as.integer(str_sub(var, 1, 4)),
    interval = as.integer(str_sub(var, 6))
  ) %>%
  select(-var)

#====================================================
# 4. Join DM + RI
#====================================================
grids_long <- dm_long %>%
  left_join(ri_long, by = c("grid_id", "STATE", "year", "interval"))

#====================================================
# 5. Compute payout rate + DM share (state-level)
#====================================================
dm_summary_state <- grids_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(DM), !is.na(RI)) %>%
  group_by(STATE, DM) %>%
  summarise(
    total_intervals = n(),
    payout_rate = mean(RI <= ri_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(STATE) %>%
  mutate(
    dm_share = total_intervals / sum(total_intervals)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#====================================================
# 6. Add ALL-states row
#====================================================
dm_summary_all <- grids_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(DM), !is.na(RI)) %>%
  group_by(DM) %>%
  summarise(
    total_intervals = n(),
    payout_rate = mean(RI <= ri_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    STATE = "ALL",
    dm_share = total_intervals / sum(total_intervals)
  )

dm_summary <- bind_rows(dm_summary_state, dm_summary_all)

#====================================================
# 7. Size bins (ordered factor)
#====================================================
dm_summary <- dm_summary %>%
  mutate(
    size_category = case_when(
      dm_share < 0.05 ~ "0–5%",
      dm_share < 0.10 ~ "5–10%",
      dm_share < 0.20 ~ "10–20%",
      TRUE ~ ">20%"
    ),
    size_category = factor(
      size_category,
      levels = c("0–5%", "5–10%", "10–20%", ">20%")
    )
  )

# Ensure ALL is last on x-axis
dm_summary$STATE <- factor(
  dm_summary$STATE,
  levels = c(sort(unique(dm_summary_state$STATE)), "ALL")
)

#====================================================
# 8. Plot
#====================================================
p_payout_rate_state <- ggplot(dm_summary,
       aes(x = STATE,
           y = payout_rate,
           group = factor(DM),
           color = factor(DM))) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  
  geom_point(aes(size = size_category)) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = usdm_colors,
                     name = "DM Category") +
  
  scale_size_manual(
    values = c("0–5%" = 2,
               "5–10%" = 3,
               "10–20%" = 4,
               ">20%" = 5),
    name = "% of Grid-Intervals\nin State",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.20),        # major gridlines every 10%
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "State",
    y = "Payout Rate (RI ≤ 0.90)",
    title = "Payout Frequency by Drought Category and State",
    subtitle = "Point size reflects frequency of drought classification"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

p_payout_rate_state

png(here("data/outputs/figures/p_payout_rate_state.png"),
    width = 1200,
    height = 800)
plot(p_payout_rate_state)
dev.off()


```

## DM payouts by year

```{r}

#====================================================
# 5b. Compute payout rate + DM share (year-level)
#====================================================
dm_summary_year <- grids_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(DM), !is.na(RI), year >= 2010, year <= 2025) %>%
  group_by(year, DM) %>%
  summarise(
    total_intervals = n(),
    payout_rate = mean(RI <= ri_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    dm_share = total_intervals / sum(total_intervals)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    size_category = case_when(
      dm_share < 0.05 ~ "0–5%",
      dm_share < 0.10 ~ "5–10%",
      dm_share < 0.20 ~ "10–20%",
      TRUE ~ ">20%"
    ),
    size_category = factor(
      size_category,
      levels = c("0–5%", "5–10%", "10–20%", ">20%")
    )
  )

#====================================================
# 6b. Plot by year
#====================================================
p_payout_rate_year <-  ggplot(dm_summary_year,
       aes(x = factor(year),
           y = payout_rate,
           group = factor(DM),
           color = factor(DM))) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  
  geom_point(aes(size = size_category)) +   # only plots where obs exist
  
  scale_color_manual(values = usdm_colors,
                     name = "DM Category") +
  
  scale_size_manual(
    values = c("0–5%" = 2,
               "5–10%" = 3,
               "10–20%" = 4,
               ">20%" = 5),
    name = "% of Grid-Intervals\nin Year",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.20),        # major gridlines every 10%
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Payout Rate (RI ≤ 0.90)",
    title = "Payout Frequency by Drought Category and Year (2010–2015)",
    subtitle = "Point size reflects frequency of drought classification within year"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

p_payout_rate_year

png(here("data/outputs/figures/p_payout_rate_year.png"),
    width = 1200,
    height = 800)
plot(p_payout_rate_year)
dev.off()
```

## RI line plot by year

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(sf)

#-----------------------------
# 1. Settings
#-----------------------------
years <- 2010:2025
intervals <- 625:635

thresholds <- c(0.70, 0.80, 0.90)

RI_cols <- expand.grid(years, intervals) |>
  apply(1, \(x) paste0("cpc_index_", x[1], "_", x[2]))

#-----------------------------
# 2. Pivot RI long
#-----------------------------
ri_long <- grids %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(all_of(RI_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "colname",
    values_to = "RI"
  ) %>%
  # Extract year + interval
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(str_extract(colname, "(?<=cpc_index_)\\d{4}")),
    interval = as.integer(str_extract(colname, "(?<=_)\\d{3}$"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(RI))

#-----------------------------
# 3. Expand for all thresholds
#-----------------------------
ri_thresh_long <- ri_long %>%
  crossing(threshold = thresholds) %>%
  mutate(
    payout = RI <= threshold
  )

#-----------------------------
# 4. Aggregate % payout by year
#-----------------------------
ts_data <- ri_thresh_long %>%
  group_by(year, threshold) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_payout = mean(payout) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#-----------------------------
# 5. Plot
#-----------------------------
# 1. Load required libraries

# 2. Example plot object (replace df + vars with yours)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Data for line labels (last year only, selected thresholds)
line_labels <- ts_data %>%
  filter(threshold %in% c(0.9, 0.8, 0.7)) %>%
  group_by(threshold) %>%
  filter(year == max(year)) %>%
  ungroup()

line_labels$label = paste0("RI = ", str_pad(line_labels$threshold, side = "right", pad = 0, width = 4))

p_ri_year <- ggplot(ts_data, aes(x = year, y = pct_payout, group = threshold)) +
  
  # Grey thin lines (all except 0.90)
  geom_line(
    data = ts_data %>% filter(threshold != 0.90),
    color = "grey60",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  
  # Bold black 0.90 line
  geom_line(
    data = ts_data %>% filter(threshold == 0.90),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  
  # 2. Line end labels
  geom_text(
    data = line_labels,
    aes(label = label),
    hjust = 0.5,          # push text slightly right
    vjust = 0.4,
    size = 3.8
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, 2025, 2)) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 10),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Percent of Grid-Intervals Triggering PRF Payouts by Year",
    subtitle = "RI Threshold Sensitivity",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percent of Grid-Intervals with Payout"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_ri_year

png(here("data/outputs/figures/p_ri_year.png"),
    width = 600,
    height = 400)
plot(p_ri_year)
dev.off()






```


## DM by year plot

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

#-----------------------------
# 1. Settings
#-----------------------------
years <- 2010:2025
intervals <- 625:635
dm_thresholds <- 0:4  # thresholds for DM

#-----------------------------
# 2. Compute % of grid-intervals per year and threshold
#-----------------------------
ts_dm_data <- expand.grid(year = years, threshold = dm_thresholds) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Store columns as a list
    DM_median_cols = list(paste0("DM_median_", year, "_", intervals)),
    
    # Compute #cells >= threshold
    n_hit = sum(as.matrix(grids[, DM_median_cols]) >= threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Total valid cells
    n_total = sum(!is.na(as.matrix(grids[, DM_median_cols]))),
    
    pct_grids = n_hit / n_total * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(year, threshold, pct_grids)

#-----------------------------
# 3. Line-end labels (last year)
#-----------------------------
line_labels <- ts_dm_data %>%
  filter(year == max(year)) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("DM ≥ ", threshold))

#-----------------------------
# 4. Plot
#-----------------------------
p_dm_year <- ggplot(ts_dm_data, aes(x = year, y = pct_grids, group = threshold)) +
  
  # Thin grey lines for DM 0–3
  geom_line(data = ts_dm_data %>% filter(threshold != 4),
            color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # Thick black line for DM 4
  geom_line(data = ts_dm_data %>% filter(threshold == 4),
            color = "black", linewidth = 1.4) +
  
  # Line-end labels
  geom_text(data = line_labels,
            aes(label = label),
            hjust = 0.4,
            vjust = 0.5,
            size = 3.8) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, 2025, 2)) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100),
                     breaks = seq(0, 100, 10),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Percent of Grid-Intervals by Drought Severity",
    subtitle = "DM Threshold Sensitivity",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percent of Grid-Intervals Meeting Threshold"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_dm_year
#-----------------------------
# 5. Export PNG
#-----------------------------
png(here("data/outputs/figures/p_dm_year.png"),
    width = 600, height = 400)

plot(p_dm_year)

dev.off()

```

## missed payout by year

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

#-----------------------------
# 1. Settings
#-----------------------------
years <- 2010:2025
intervals <- 625:635
ri_threshold <- 0.9
dm_threshold <- 4

#-----------------------------
# 2. Compute % for DM=4 total and split by RI
#-----------------------------
ts_dm_ri <- lapply(years, function(yr){
  
  DM_cols <- paste0("DM_median_", yr, "_", intervals)
  RI_cols <- paste0("cpc_index_", yr, "_", intervals)
  
  dm_vals <- as.matrix(grids[, DM_cols])
  ri_vals <- as.matrix(grids[, RI_cols])
  
  # Total DM >= 4
  total_hit <- sum(dm_vals >= dm_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_cells <- sum(!is.na(dm_vals))
  pct_dm4 <- total_hit / total_cells * 100
  
  # DM >=4 AND RI <= 0.9
  payout_hit <- sum(dm_vals >= dm_threshold & ri_vals <= ri_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  pct_payout <- payout_hit / total_cells * 100
  
  # DM >=4 AND RI > 0.9
  no_payout_hit <- sum(dm_vals >= dm_threshold & ri_vals > ri_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  pct_no_payout <- no_payout_hit / total_cells * 100
  
  data.frame(
    year = yr,
    pct_dm4 = pct_dm4,
    pct_payout = pct_payout,
    pct_no_payout = pct_no_payout
  )
  
}) %>% bind_rows()

#-----------------------------
# 3. Plot
#-----------------------------
p_dm4_zoom <- ggplot(ts_dm_ri, aes(x = year)) +
  
  # DM >=4 total (optional, black line)
  geom_line(aes(y = pct_dm4), color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  # DM=4 & RI <=0.9
  geom_line(aes(y = pct_payout), color = "blue", linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  # DM=4 & RI >0.9
  geom_line(aes(y = pct_no_payout), color = "red", linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, 2025, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 25), breaks = seq(0, 25, 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  labs(
    title = "DM = 4 Grid-Intervals Split by RI",
    subtitle = "Blue = payout (RI ≤ 0.9), Red = no payout (RI > 0.9)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percent of Grid-Intervals"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_dm4_zoom

#-----------------------------
# 4. Export PNG
#-----------------------------
png(here("data/outputs/figures/p_dm4_zoom.png"),
    width = 600, height = 400)

plot(p_dm4_zoom)

dev.off()











```
